name: project-documentation
description: Repository documentation and reusable knowledge extraction with audit-first routing, semantic coordination ownership, reconciliation, continuation, contamination, update, release, and Agent Skill workflows.

interface.shortDescription: Document, reconcile, and inspect reusable repository knowledge
interface.longDescription: Creates and maintains GitHub-facing presentation documentation and detailed internal project knowledge, starts ambiguous invocations with a read-only audit, keeps handoff and project-memory coordination artifacts outside ordinary documentation mutation unless explicitly requested, reconciles accepted plans with implementation, identifies development residue and accidental project-specific contamination, extracts reusable capabilities, and documents Agent Skills and plugins.
defaultPrompt: Audit this repository with project-documentation. Start read-only and tell me which documentation modes are applicable before changing files.

Update only maintained documentation affected by the current implementation changes and report coordination or project-memory inconsistencies separately without rewriting them unless explicitly requested.
Compare the accepted project plan with the current implementation and document the delta internally.
Inspect this repository for abandoned or superseded development residue before we continue work.
Check this reusable project for accidental legacy-example or project-specific contamination.
Document this Agent Skill repository for users and maintainers.
